reviews.title: Awkward to use
reviews.text: The app functions well enough, but it’s a little hard to use. The controls feel basic and limited, and it’s extremely hard to renew a book when time lapses. Also, if you log out, there’s no quick and simple way to log back in. It forces you down a registration path again. Overall, it makes it harder to use compared to similar apps.

reviews.title: Skips Ahead
reviews.text: This app drives me crazy.  When I read a book, it randomly skips ahead a random number of pages.  So I have to look at the page number every time I swipe, in case it jumps ahead.  It is not my swiping.  When it happens, it can take me several times starting over to finally get it to only move forward one page.  Drives me crazy! Also Libby has so much better functionality.  You can rate every book you read, or at least mark that you have read it.  I read a lot, and I have to use Goodreads to keep track of Cloud Library books I have read.

reviews.title: Chapter skip bug still there
reviews.text: The bug happens at the beginning of chapters for infinite scroll. Sometimes you scroll up to continue reading but it skips all the way to the next chapter and makes you lose your place. You have to go back two chapters prior to reach the beginning of the chapter you were on and find your place again. It's pretty inconvenient to repetitively have to do deal with this.

reviews.title: Always crashing
reviews.text: This app has the potential to be good but it’s so far from it currently. Crashes constantly, search function hardly works (don’t you dare misspell a word or ‘we don’t have that, idiot’), and not being able to send to Kindle— though I assume that’s Amazon not playing nicely. Fox all the problems and I’d love to use this app. Otherwise I hope my library will switch to Libby.

reviews.title: Should be improved
reviews.text:
I use this app almost every day, and with my library’s selection, I’m pretty happy, but the lack of otherwise common features, it can be incredibly frustration. To start, the saved list only sorts by author name or title, meaning books that you just saved get buried somewhere in the list. There should be a sort by date added at a minimum, and even better, let you make lists of your own, so people can sort books they’ve saved and want to check out later. Being able to sort by length would also be incredible convenient. They have that data on every book already (audio length, and pages). 

Another incredibly annoying feature that should exist is an option to stop the book at the end of the chapter/section when listening to an audiobook. This is literally the only app that doesn’t have that built in already. Oh, you’re cleaning and want to listen to one chapter, better run to your phone and pause it. Oh, you’re in bed going to sleep and want to just finish up a section, too bad. The only option is to pause at a specific set time (5, 10 minutes, etc), which could stop the book one paragraph into a new chapter, a few words before the chapter ends, or mid sentence, you never know. 

Otherwise, great app, just lacking in common features that make it feel like I’m using something from decades ago that’s not been updated since.
